tool_schemas.name: book_trip
tool_schemas.description: Book a flight and a hotel together and charge the corporate card.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome, including when the original failed partway (the retry then reports what committed). Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

Trip booked for Dana Lee — confirmed on both legs.

**Flight — R0001 (confirmed)**

- $289

**Hotel — R0002 (confirmed)**
- Midtown Lodge (H1), New York, check-in 2026-11-12, 2 nights
- $189/night, $378 total
- Cheapest New York hotel under $250/night; Harbor Inn ($239/night) and Plaza Grand ($459/night) were the alternatives.

**Total charged: $667** — under the $1000 threshold, so no manager approval was required.

One thing worth flagging: the combined `book_trip` call failed partway. On the first attempt it timed out, and a retry with the same idempotency key reported the original partial failure — the flight had committed but the hotel reservation errored internally. I verified the state via reservations, then booked the hotel separately, which is why there are two separate reservations rather than one combined trip record. Total cost is the same and nothing was double-charged.
